Hi Alan — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; I'm attaching a compact package (see attachments) and a one-page mapping doc. If anything needs additional detail we can hop on a 30-min call this week.

Short answers:
- BYOK: Remote HSM import (wrapped key import) or customer-managed HSM import via a standardized import token. Private deployment only: our agents perform import into customer HSMs; in Hosted mode we support tenant-wrapped BYOK where HDK never leaves customer KMS/HSM. Keys are never exported in plaintext from an HSM.
- HSM attestation: attached PDF includes vendor (Thales/Luna or AWS CloudHSM depending on deployment), model, FIPS 140-2/3 status and attestation chain.
- Rotation: default supported rotation hooks via our KMS API. We support scheduled rotations and can configure a 90-day cadence. We also offer phased rollover (primary->secondary) to ensure zero downtime.
- TLS: we support TLS1.2+ with recommended TLS1.3 for all public endpoints. Mutual TLS is supported for Private deployment control plane and customer-facing private endpoints. Attached CSV lists cipher suites and recommended configuration.
- Delivery: package + playbook attached; I've also included a short runbook that maps your questionnaire fields to Redwood terminology.

Next steps: let us know if you want the full HSM attestation (signed/redacted) or an initial summary. We can provide the signed attestation by Oct 9 if that meets your deadline — I'll coordinate internally.

Thanks,

Ben — good to proceed. Quick notes for the package I'll attach: 

- Attestation: we can provide the signed attestation for the module(s) we use in Private (Thales Luna SA8 / HSM model LUNA-7), including the certificate chain and FIPS 140-2/3 validation snapshots. We will redact internal job IDs and customer tenant identifiers.
- BYOK import: our playbook documents two modes: (1) Remote wrapped import (customer wraps with their KMS and passes wrapped key to Redwood import API) and (2) On-prem injection via partner ops for air-gapped or on-site HSMs. In neither mode does cleartext key material leave the customer boundary for customer-managed HSMs.
- Rotation: recommend presenting three tiers in the RFP playbook: "Standard (90 days)", "High-frequency (30/60 days)" and "Low-frequency (180 days)". We support all via our KMS API; the playbook includes sample curl commands and sample Idempotent rollovers.
- TLS: we only support TLS 1.3 on public hosted endpoints but can enable TLS 1.2 for legacy customers when required; we provide an explicit cipher matrix (see attached CSV). mTLS for private control plane requires a CA-signed cert from the customer; we accept PEM bundles or can issue subordinate certs when requested.

I'll attach the signed attestation PDF and the curated snippets for the RFP. Mark us approved to send to Nova as long as we redact tenant ids.

-Laura
